title: bassia scoparia var. trichophylla
intro: Bassia scoparia var. trichophylla, commonly known as Japanese wormwood or huang qin, is a plant species in the Amaranthaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system, as well as its use as a natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of B. scoparia var. trichophylla are attributed to its ability to stimulate the circulation, reduce fever, and ease respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
